answer_prose: Courses have distinct recorded pacing profiles. Choose a city to see where runners tend to speed up or slow down relative to their own average.
detail_prose: Individual split profiles are available for 28 cities with at least 100 eligible finishes each.

charts.title: Pace through the selected course
charts.note: Every runner is normalized before aggregation. This is an observed city profile, not an elevation-adjusted pacing prescription.
